meta.title: Silicon Valley Judo competitor analysis — launch film
meta.skill: product-launch-motion (AbubakrChan) as the motion playbook, built in Remotion because the brief requires a Remotion project. memex product-launch-video storyboard + Remotion frame rules used as the supplement.
decisions: One card morphs through every state. Cuts are blur swaps inside that card.
Camera is a damped spring on pan and a 2% push, not a cut.
A coach cursor drives the clicks: open, quick capture, win, ippon, save, Today, print pack.
Copy and names come from scripts/ui-smoke/fixtures.mjs. No invented athletes, results, or features.
Brand type and the single blue accent. No second hue, no emoji, no purple gradient.
Voice is espeak-ng en-us+m3 because that is the offline TTS on the machine. Captions carry the same lines.
Score, clicks, and whooshes are synthesized in-repo. No stock music.
